what: The section stays pinned at screen center for a very long time (default 2000vh, phone 800vh) while a narrow, tall vertical photo in the center (36.7vw × 91.36svh, phone 63.08vw × 45.2svh) slowly widens to fill the screen (100vw × 100svh) over 1900vh (phone 500vh) (scrub .8). When steps is given, fx-pw-step-N is added each time progress passes that value, so the text can change in turn

options.length: How long it stays stuck, default 2000vh (phone 800vh)
options.scrub: Follow-up delay in seconds, default .8 — if true, binds right at the scroll position with no delay
options.steps: Progress threshold list ‹0,0.2,0.4,0.6› — crossing each adds fx-pw-step-1 … classes
options.start: ScrollTrigger start (both fixed and widened), default center center — to attach the hero frame from the top use top 20px
options.pin: If false, only widens (shrinks) without pinning, default true

use:
…

— Grow from a square: data-fx-pin-widen="from: 25vw; from-h: 25vw; to: 94.44vw; to-h: 50.69vw; length: 2800vh; grow: 2800vh; scrub: .7; steps: 0,0.2,0.4,0.6"

from.where: index.html .p-home-mv (Hero — 36.7vw×91.358svh → 100vw×100svh, pinned 2000vh · widening at 1900vh, scrub .8) · .p-home-moment__lead-scrub (25vw square → 94.44vw×50.69vw, 2800vh, scrub .7, scroll01~04 at progress 0·.2·.4·.6)

index.html .jf-business (business section — a centered 25vw square photo expands to 100vw × screen ratio over 200vh · scrub .7 · at progress .2 · .4 · .6 the four photos switch in .25s, and the inner 1→1.18 scale is site code) · touch devices use the phone version (TopBusinessSP) — from the section top edge over 140vh a 50vw square → 100vw × screen height, inner 1→1.1 scale, tied directly to the scroll position (no delay), and the photo frame is sticky
from.options: from: 25vw; from-h: 25vw; length: 200vh; scrub: .7; steps: .2,.4,.6 · phone version from: 50vw; from-h: 50vw; to-h: 100svh; start: top top; grow: 140vh; pin: false; scrub: true; steps: .2,.4,.6

from.where: index.html .mv-pin > .mv-frame — the full-screen Hero photo frame stays stuck 20px from the top and shrinks from 100% · 100vh to 80% · 90vh over 1000px (scrub 1). On phones it is not pinned, and only the width shrinks to 75% over 550px starting 250px from the top
from.options: from: 100%; from-h: 100vh; to: 80%; to-h: 90vh; length: 1000; grow: 1000; scrub: 1; start: top 20px · phone pin: false; start: top 250px; grow: 550; to: 75%

note: The original sets pinning (empty timeline + pin) and sizing (fromTo) separately — so the part is split in two to take the same length separately. The pin is very long, so in the app view length and grow are reduced
